brief_summary: The purpose of the present study is to determine if use of dietary supplement tauroursodeoxycholic acid enhances insulin-stimulated leg blood flow and glucose disposal.
brief_title: Effects of Dietary Supplement Tauroursodeoxycholic Acid on Vascular Function

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetes diagnosed by primary physician
* Body mass index less then 43 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Recent weight gain or loss (\>5% body weight in the last 3 months)
* Pregnancy
* Consumption of \>14 alcoholic beverages per week
* Changes in the medication use or dose within the last 3 months
* Known cardiovascular or pulmonary disease
* Taking medication for advanced retinopathy or neuropathy
* Taking prescription anticoagulants
* Nicotine use

official_title: Targeting Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress to Correct Vascular Insulin Resistance and Glycemic Dysregulation
